title: Business Office Standard — Settling the Residency Ledger in an Independent Living Closing Amount
content:
## Standard

**Ledger settlement.** The closing amount of an Independent Living Residency Agreement settles the residency ledger as it stands, every monthly fee, community fee, service fee and late fee charge, every returned payment and every credit balance refund less every payment and every credit: where the ledger balance is owed, it is added to the closing amount; where the ledger balance is a credit, it is taken off the closing amount, never below zero; where the ledger balance is zero, the closing amount stands as computed.

**Final month charge.** The closing amount is worked out only after the ledger carries, wherever the residency's fees end after the last day already billed, a monthly fee charge for the final month running from its first day through the date the fees end.

Restated in the same terms: where the residency's fees end after the last day already billed, the ledger must carry a monthly fee charge for the final month, from its first day through the date the fees end, before the closing amount is worked out.

## Ledger balance — input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

| Ledger | Ledger balance | Closing amount before the ledger | Closing amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Charges 26,400.00; payments 23,900.00; credits 120.00 | 2,380.00 owed | 280.00 | 2,660.00 |
| Charges 18,000.00; payments 18,150.00 | 150.00 credit | 280.00 | 130.00 |
| Charges 18,000.00; payments 18,500.00 | 500.00 credit | 280.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| Charges 18,000.00; returned payment 1,000.00; payments 19,000.00 | Zero | 280.00 | 280.00 |

"Charges" here are the monthly fee, community fee, service fee and late fee charges; returned payments and credit balance refunds count on the same side as charges.
